limitations: Single participant and two runs only; no population interval, hypothesis test, or generalization.
Run position was not randomized and task composition may differ; no causal practice, fatigue, learning, loss-aversion, or preference claim.
Estimand concerns observed valid responses, not every offered decision. No meaning or correctness inferred from choice codes.

Task-supplied source audit reports 65 of 86 absent-code rows in sub-05/run-01. This differential missingness is a material dataset-level selection limitation; it was not independently re-audited in this sub-01-only stage.
Task-supplied positive-RT absent-code case in sub-15/run-03 is outside this stage; the general rule excludes such contradictions without repair.
Current BIDS validation, remote retrieval, clean-environment rebuild, alternate-platform replay, and DataLad run/rerun are unattempted. Local artifact saving is not a DataLad transformation record.
No imaging data, downloads, dependency installation, containers, external services, or remote jobs used.
scientific_conclusion: For sub-01, run-03 minus run-01 median decision RT was -11.000 ms among observed valid responses. This is a descriptive temporal association for one participant; no population inference or causal interpretation is supported.

self_containment.demonstrated: Local event inputs, source metadata, code, tables, report and environment specification are reachable from this working dataset.
self_containment.untested: Fresh acquisition and full offline environment reconstruction.

trackability.demonstrated: Pinned input revision and byte equality to Git blobs; SHA-256 input/component/output manifests and row-level audit.
trackability.untested: No complete lifetime provenance claim; any local DataLad transformation record must be inspected separately.

actionability.demonstrated: Executable replay command provided; verification results recorded separately. Local scientific outputs replayed byte-for-byte and independent Decimal summaries agreed.

modularity.demonstrated: Input subdataset, code, derivatives and reports are separate components.

portability.demonstrated: Standard-library Python analysis, relative project paths and supplied Pixi manifest/lock; versions recorded.
portability.untested: Other platforms and fresh builds; the supplied Pixi environment targets osx-arm64.

ephemerality.demonstrated: Verification uses a temporary output directory when run.
ephemerality.untested: Disposable execution environment or clean-machine execution; existing local environment reused.

distributability.demonstrated: Source declares PDDL v1.0 and attribution is preserved; portable text/vector outputs produced locally.
distributability.untested: Persistent third-party retrieval, publication, and independent availability.
